info.title: Record Enrichment API
info.description: Collect work, location, shift and salary details from your own candidate database. You need two things: your **key id** and your **secret**. Everything else is generated. See Authentication for how.

post.description:
Create the questions you want candidates to answer and the window they are contacted in. It is created once and never edited: different questions mean a new enrichment. Returns `enrichment_id`. Record prepares translations and voice in the background: read the enrichment until `questions_status` is `ready`.

**Scope:** `enrichment:write` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first answer (kept 24 h). Leave empty in Try it: a new one is made for every call.

external_id.description: Your own id (1 to 128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -)

sms_backup.description: Also send an SMS with the link; default false

delivery.description: WhatsApp and the AI voice call are always on; only SMS is optional

language.description: Opening language of messages and calls (the candidate can switch)

days.description: Days messages and calls may go out, each listed once

schedule.description: Required. Send all six: `language` (english, hindi, tamil, kannada, telugu, malayalam, bengali, marathi), `start_time` and `end_time` ("HH:MM", start before end), `days` (mon…sun, each once), `timezone` (IANA), `max_retries` 1 to 20, `retry_after_hours` 1 to 48.

question_text.description: What Record asks the candidate, up to 300 characters

type.description: yes_no is answered with a tap, voice is spoken or recorded

preferred_answer.description: Required for yes_no: the answer that counts as qualified

required.description: A candidate completes only after answering every required question

questions.description: 1 to 15 questions. An enrichment is never edited: different questions mean a new enrichment

questions.question_text: Are you open to a new job right now?
Tell us about the work you do and where you want to work.

questions_status.description: Translation and voice of the questions. Campaigns wait for ready, then go out by themselves; failed is retried when you create a campaign

sent.description: Candidates whose WhatsApp invite went out

completed.description: Candidates who finished, including those who declined

is_external.description: true when created through the Partner API, false when made in the Record playground

questions.question_text: Are you open to a new job right now?
Tell us about the work you do and where you want to work.

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: `name`, `schedule` or `questions` missing, a `yes_no` question without `preferred_answer`, `start_time` not before `end_time`, an unknown language, empty or repeated `days`, or an unknown field.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: A TEST key's organisation already has 5 active enrichments. Archive one.

409.description: `CONFLICT`: `external_id` is already used by another enrichment.

JavaScript
Python

res = call("POST", "/api/v1/partner/enrichments", {
    "external_id": "enr-chennai-warehouse",
    "name": "Warehouse talent pool - Chennai",
    "schedule": {
        "language": "english",
        "start_time": "10:00",
        "end_time": "18:00",
        "days": [
            "mon",
            "tue",
            "wed",
            "thu",
            "fri",
            "sat"
        ],
        "timezone": "Asia/Kolkata",
        "max_retries": 3,
        "retry_after_hours": 4
    },
    "questions": [
        {
            "question_text": "Are you open to a new job right now?",
            "type": "yes_no",
            "preferred_answer": "yes",
            "required": True
        },
        {
            "question_text": "Tell us about the work you do and where you want to work.",
            "type": "voice",
            "required": True
        }
    ]
})
data = res.json()["data"]

**Scope:** `enrichment:write` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

post.description:
Add candidates (name and mobile number) to one of your enrichments. Record starts contacting them straight away: there is no separate start step. If the questions are still being prepared, the campaign waits and goes out by itself. Returns `campaign_id`, the candidates and every row that was skipped.

**Scope:** `enrichment:campaigns` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

> **This contacts real candidates.** Build against a TEST key first.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first answer (kept 24 h). Leave empty in Try it: a new one is made for every call.

language.description: Invite language; defaults to the enrichment's schedule language

phone_number.description: An Indian mobile number: 10 digits, or with +91

external_id.description: Your own id for the candidate; returned with their status and results

candidates.description: Required. 1 to 1,000 of `{ name, phone_number, external_id? }`. `phone_number` is an Indian mobile: 10 digits, or with `+91`. A row with an invalid number, a number that opted out, or a number already earlier in the list is skipped and returned in `skipped`; it never fails the call. `external_id` comes back on every candidate and result.

201.description: The new campaign, its candidates and the rows skipped

awaiting_questions.description: true while the questions are still being prepared; nothing goes out until they are

index.description: Position in the candidates you sent, from 0

skipped.description: Every row left out and why. Skipped rows are never an error

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: No candidate has a contactable number (`details` say why), or a field is missing or unknown.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: The enrichment was made in the playground, or a TEST key would exceed 50 candidates in this enrichment.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: No such enrichment, or it is archived.

429.description: `DAILY_CAP`: The key has put its daily allowance of different people into campaigns (2,000, or 200 for a TEST key). Resets at midnight IST.

post.description:
Register the HTTPS URL that receives each candidate's result as soon as they finish an enrichment. Send `event_types: ["enrichment.result"]`: enrichment results are opt-in, and the key needs an enrichment scope as well as `webhooks:manage`. Deliveries are signed with your API secret key and retried until you answer `2xx`.

**Scope:** `webhooks:manage` · **Idempotency-Key:** optional

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first answer (kept 24 h). Leave empty in Try it: a new one is made for every call.

url.description: Your HTTPS endpoint (port 443, public host). Record POSTs each event here and counts any 2xx as the acknowledgement

event_types.description: Default: candidate.result. Add enrichment.result to also receive the final result of each Enrichment candidate (needs an enrichment scope)

backfill_from.description: Also deliver events from this time on (at most 30 days back)

201.description: The endpoint (the existing one when this URL was already registered)

status.description: auto_paused: Record stopped sending after 20 failures in a row. Fix the endpoint, then PATCH status active

existing.description: true when this URL was already registered: nothing new was created

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: URL not https, a private address, a port other than 443, or an unknown event type.

post.description:
Use this when you cannot expose a URL, or as a safety net next to the webhook. Send `type: "enrichment.result"`, and the `ack` ids of the events you already processed, and get the next events back. Needs `events:read` and an enrichment scope.

**Scope:** `events:read`

ack.description: Up to 100 ids of events you processed. They are acknowledged before the page is read, so they do not come back

status.description: `unacked` (default) gives only events you have not confirmed. `all` replays history (use it with `from`).

from.description: Only events created at or after this time (replay)

after.description: Only events with a higher `sequence` than this

event_id.description: Stable forever. Keep the ones you processed and skip repeats

version.description: Rises each time the same candidate's result changes. Keep the highest. An enrichment.result event is almost always version 1

sequence.description: Order of events in your stream

backfill.description: true when the event was created for a webhook backfill

acknowledged.description: true once you acknowledged it (webhook 2xx, or listed in `ack` of POST /events/pull)

external_id.description: Your own id for the candidate, if you sent one

job_id.description: Your job id; null for a mandate created without one

status.description: pending: not finished yet. completed: finished, `output` holds what Record collected. declined: the candidate said not interested. failed: no result could be got, see `reason`

reason.description: Only for failed. undeliverable: the invite could not be delivered. no_response: every attempt went unanswered

attempts.description: Times Record tried to reach the candidate: invite, follow-ups and phone calls

location_name.description: The town the candidate was in when they allowed location on the verification link. null when they denied it, it could not be looked up, or they verified by phone call

metadata.description: The `metadata` you sent for this candidate, unchanged

enrichment.description: Answers to your screening questions, keyed by the question's text

evidenceClass.description: Sufficient, Partial, Minimal, Incorrect or No Response

call_recording_url.description: The phone call's recording, when they verified by call

evidenceClass.description: Sufficient, Partial, Minimal, Incorrect or No Response

score.description: Score and the maximum as one value, like 7.5/10

duration_seconds.description: Length of the video of this answer, in seconds; null when there is no video

skill_verification.description: The skill-verification result and what the candidate said

transcript.description: What they said, in their own words; left out when empty

interest_collection.description: Other roles the candidate is open to

output.description: What Record collected. A section appears only once its data exists, and only if that check ran for the job

summary.description: answered_count, required_count, qualified_count, open_to_work, work, location, disinterest_reason, partial

value.description: true or false for yes_no; a text summary for voice

data.description: A result record for candidate.result, an enrichment result for enrichment.result (the same record as GET /enrichments/{enrichment_id}/results)

acknowledged.description: How many of the `ack` ids were newly acknowledged by this call

pending.description: How many unacknowledged events you have in all

next_cursor.description: Pass as `after` for the next page

answers.question_text: Are you open to a new job right now?
Tell us about the work you do and where you want to work.

400.description: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: An `ack` id that is not an event id, more than 100 ids, a bad date, or `limit` above 100.
